checks.name: Circular avatar ring, spacing and roof anchors remain readable on the unchanged desktop map

Keyboard avatar activation and Escape retain accessible selection

Complete building hover lift moves both roof bounds and avatar anchor together
Mobile resize keeps all five markers distinct and selectable with no horizontal overflow
Narrow viewport wraps the avatar fan; near-edge projection keeps circles inside the screen
Expired and future fixtures are omitted; active markers expire without another network request
Presence failures clear stale markers, leave startup/map usable, and recover on refresh
Unknown avatar URLs remain initials and malformed payload cannot inject markup
Normal synthetic browser run has no JavaScript errors or failed map assets

limitations: Headless Chrome using software WebGL; mobile viewport emulated, no physical device or touch gesture measurements.
Tracked screenshots use synthetic people/initials only; live names, IDs and portraits are excluded from tracked evidence.
No cloud writes, model requests, deployment or unrelated process changes.
